test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A person walks 6 km west, then 8 km north, and finally 6 km east. In which direction is he from his starting point?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc56d8339739fdfe27a908121be0fe21a59fd5a6993d3341f5b0d6ee14c5dd7a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a6b5d6d74fd2b4654b1f34087707027f833cf073c609a5b9cd3cb9e7d9463d1.png] 

6 km west and 6 km east cancel each other

⇒ Net horizontal displacement = 0

Vertical movement

⇒ 8 km north

⇒ Final position = 8 km north of starting point

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3635fbbf0b60d79cef601d67641536dbc00718182ebbd9b576a6ba78ea0c32c.png] 

∴ He is in the North direction from his starting point. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28d686f8426705d8ab14550a18874acc44a96f105a00947fbacac31d3bf2c9eb.png]
